{{Quote|Take ten warriors to the nearest weapons lockers and gather all the charrics and extra energy packs you can carry. Bring them here. The pirates will soon come through the breach. We must be ready for them.|Commander Kres'ten'tarthi|<ref name="RSBF">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref>}}
'''Charric rifles''' were a type of [[Charric/Legends|charric]]. [[Sniper/Legends|Chiss sharpshooter]]s were armed with [[Charric rifle|charric]] [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]].<ref name="DK III: SW" />

==History==
{{Quote|Tlarik, help Jag Fel gather the weapons. All others, queue up. Take as much as you can carry at a run, then return to Commander Stent for instructions.|Cadet commander Shawnkyr Nuruodo|<ref name="RSBF" />}}
The [[Charric/Legends|charric]] [[Disruptor rifle/Legends|disruptor rifles]] were exceedingly rare in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Dark Wars]], a string of conflicts<ref name="kotorcg">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> that were fought between leftovers of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="kotor2" /> In [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> they could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="kotor2" />

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="RSBF Date">The events of ''[[Red Sky, Blue Flame]]'' take place in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> when the [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy]] was [[Battle of Rhigar|attacked]] by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[cadet commander]] [[Shawnkyr Nuruodo]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] [[Fenlish]] and [[Khana]] to gather eight charric [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] and [[Power cell/Legends|energy packs]]. The cadets ran to a nearby weapons cache, which they could not open, asking Nuruodo to open it; however, she was unable to do so. [[Human/Legends|Human]] cadet [[Jagged Fel]] then opened the cache with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], giving part of its contents to the cadet commander. Fel continued to gather the weapons and giving them to cadets, while he strapped the remaining charric rifles over his shoulders until he could barely stand under their weight. Shortly after, under Nuruodo's directive, cadets fled to the academy's [[Forest/Legends|forests]]. The battle ended with the pirates' defeat.<ref name="RSBF" />

In [[36 ABY]], during the [[Battle of Tenupe]]<ref name="DK III: SW" /> [[Sniper/Legends|Chiss sharpshooter]]s were armed with charric [[Charric rifle|sniper rifles]] that capable of firing a [[maser]] bolt for several hundred meters—significantly farther than its smaller handgun counterparts—the rifle possessed considerable more range, and was also equipped with a sensor rod for electronic magnification.<ref name="DK III: SW" />
